summary: Confirmed stored XSS vulnerability in DVWA xss_s page (security=low). The guestbook form accepts txtName (name) and mtxMessage (message) parameters and stores them in a MySQL database without HTML encoding. Injected '<script>alert(1)</script>' in the message field and '<script>alert(2)</script>' in the name field — both payloads were stored in the database and reflected verbatim in the HTML response on subsequent page loads. PHP source confirms the application uses mysqli_real_escape_string() only for SQL injection prevention, with no htmlspecialchars() or any output encoding.
